RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: phaos & claude
RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: Simple Transients
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Transient detection for the sample editor, the companion of Simple Browser: step from hit to hit (drum hits in a loop, words in a recording), move the selection's start and end transient by transient, and crop single hits or parts of loops. Sensitivity, Threshold and Min gap tune the detection; the tool suggests keys that are free in your key bindings. Press Help for all keys.
